findings.problem: The gitleaks command now uses `--log-level error` which will suppress informational messages and only show errors.
findings.why: This reduces visibility into gitleaks' scanning process and may hide important diagnostic information when troubleshooting issues.
findings.fix: Change `--log-level error` back to `--log-level info` to maintain visibility into the scanning process.

findings.problem: The new script fails to handle the case where the JSON report file is empty or invalid, which would cause the python command to fail.
findings.why: If `/tmp/gl-report.json` is empty or malformed, `json.load()` will raise an exception, causing the script to crash instead of gracefully reporting 0 findings.
findings.fix: Add error handling to the python command to catch JSON parsing errors and default to 0 findings, similar to the previous implementation.
